name: Grilled Chicken Wrap
description: Tender grilled chicken breast, lettuce, tomato, and chipotle mayo in a toasted whole-wheat wrap. Served with seasoned fries.

name: Club Sandwich
description: Triple-decker classic with turkey, bacon, egg, tomato, and lettuce. Served with coleslaw and fries.

name: Avocado Toast
description: Thick-cut sourdough with smashed avocado, cherry tomatoes, micro greens, and a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil.

name: Paneer Tikka Platter
description: Marinated paneer cubes grilled in tandoor, served with mint chutney, onion salad, and naan bread.

name: Caesar Salad
description: Romaine lettuce, parmesan shavings, house croutons, and classic Caesar dressing. Add grilled chicken for ₹80 extra.

name: Eggs Benedict
description: Poached eggs on toasted English muffin with smoked salmon and hollandaise sauce. Weekend breakfast special.

name: Protein Recovery Shake
description: Whey protein, banana, peanut butter, almond milk, and honey. 30g protein — the post-match essential.

name: Fresh Lime Soda
description: Hand-squeezed lime, sparkling water, salt or sugar — your choice. Refreshing and guilt-free.

name: Cold Brew Coffee
description: Slow-steeped premium arabica cold brew. Served over ice with oat milk or black.

name: Tropical Smoothie
description: Mango, pineapple, coconut water, and a hint of ginger. Naturally sweet and energising.

name: Masala Chai
description: Aromatic spiced tea brewed with whole spices, full-cream milk, and jaggery. A classic after the morning session.

name: Craft Beer — On Tap
description: Rotating selection of premium local brewery beers. Ask your server for today's special. 330ml pint glass.

name: Old Fashioned
description: Bourbon whiskey, Angostura bitters, sugar, orange zest. A club classic, prepared tableside.

name: Champagne Spritz
description: Prosecco, Aperol, and sparkling water with a fresh orange slice. Perfect for post-tournament celebrations.

name: Single Malt Whisky
description: Curated selection of Scottish and Indian single malts. Available in 30ml and 60ml pours. Ask our bar staff for the selection.

name: Virgin Mojito
description: Fresh mint, lime juice, sugar syrup, and sparkling water. All the fun, none of the spirits.
